issues.description: ClaimReview JSON-LD in generate-html.js (line 1513) uses ${counts.total} (our WIN count, currently 72) in the "claimReviewed" field, where it should use ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} (the dome's own claimed count, 69). This misrepresents what the dome claims: "The dome has 72 confirmed predictions" vs the correct "The dome claims 69 confirmed predictions." The ClaimReview schema is meant to represent the claim being reviewed (dome's own claim), not our entry count.

issues.description: WIN-053.c12 H0: The new paragraph 0 sentences invoke "monopole pair" as a label for the e^(-r/λ) functional form. A textbook magnetic-monopole field has Coulomb-like 1/r² dependence, not exponential decay. The "monopole pair" framing is correct topologically (two same-signed sources, no sink) but conflates sign structure with spatial decay profile. A careful reader could object that exponential fields are not monopole fields.
issues.suggested_fix: Decider self-apply: clarify "monopole pair" as referring to topological sign structure (two same-signed sources) distinct from the spatial decay profile, or replace with less ambiguous terminology
